text: Keep Aimparency's code-execution surface in the hands of its operator
description: Felix 2026-11-01: through the wrapper feature, an ordinary Aimparency instance is a gate to a terminal, i.e. code execution and full control of the machine. Every server that can start agents, loops or clones (backend, broker, agent sessions) must answer only its operator: loopback by default, explicit opt-in for a network interface, no driving from foreign web pages, and an operator credential before anything runs code when the stack is reachable from elsewhere. Hosting for other people (read-only or with accounts) must never inherit this capability.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Closes the two widest doors (LAN exposure and drive-by websites) without breaking the UI, MCP, mobile via adb reverse, or dev:host.

status.comment: Session sockets (0f307c81) and backend/broker (loopback + origin gate) are closed. Open: an operator credential for code-running routes on network-exposed stacks; the hosted read-only server's sync and roles wait on Felix's decision.
